evidence:
Requirement->criterion map built from task/instruction.md (lines 1-17), task/environment/instructions/hireops_rules.md (sections 1-9) and integration.md against all 56 criteria: tests/gates/render (1), gates/constraints (1), scored/functional/judge.toml (44), scored/polish/judge.toml (5), scored/visual/judge.toml (5). Every stated product behavior maps to at least one criterion:
- Roles/auth (rules s1): 401 -> hro_anonymous; 403/404 statuses -> hro_refusal_status; observer read-only -> hro_observer_readonly; candidate refused staff actions -> hro_candidate_no_staff; session-derived identity is exercised indirectly because R/T replays resend Rafael's exact captured body in other sessions.
- Jobs/candidates (s2): places 1-50 integer, blank title, HM-account-only -> hro_job_open; recruiter-only opening/adding -> hro_mgr_early_refused (+observer/candidate rows); card at bottom of Applied with name/email/source -> hro_add_candidate; invalid/case-insensitive duplicate refused at the field with typed values kept, same address on another job accepted -> hro_add_email_rules; candidate-account link -> hro_candidate_linked.
- Board (s3): one-stage moves via ordinary controls, skips refused, shown immediately to mover -> hro_move_one_stage; reject except Hired / blank reason / remembered stage -> hro_reject_reason, hro_reject_hired; reopen only to origin, reason cleared, undo restores reason -> hro_reopen; arrival at bottom -> hro_arrive_bottom; manual order shared -> hro_reorder; order survives restart -> hro_restart; Interview capacity, reorder-in-full, freed place -> hro_interview_full, hro_interview_reorder_free; manager permissions -> hro_mgr_late_stages, hro_mgr_early_refused, hro_mgr_other_job; 409 stale move + who -> hro_stale_refused, hro_refusal_status; put back + reason + focus -> hro_refused_put_back; multi-card board order from mixed stages, all-or-none, set-wide capacity -> hro_bulk_move, hro_bulk_all_or_none, hro_bulk_places; undo restores place, conflicts (move/reorder/reject by anyone; note and other-card changes do not block), undo into full Interview, once only, earlier move not undoable after a later one -> hro_undo_restores, hro_undo_conflict, hro_undo_full, hro_undo_once; note permissions + observer reads -> hro_notes; unsaved note kept per person/browser -> hro_pol_session_resume (note-draft legs).
- Activity (s4): every action type with who/what, rejection reason, newest first, all jobs vs one-job filter, observer readable -> hro_activity; refused actions add nothing -> hro_activity_refusals; entries not lost -> hro_restart.
- Live (s5, brief para 3): moves/new cards within 15 s -> hro_live_board; unread counts live -> hro_unread_counts; messages/seen live -> hro_msg_exchange, hro_seen; preserve open card, typed note, focus, scroll -> hro_pol_live_board; preserve draft/focus/open conversation view -> hro_pol_live_thread.
- Conversations (s6): participation per role -> hro_thread_access; plain text, non-blank, line breaks, Enter/Shift+Enter, empty+focused after send -> hro_msg_compose; failed send kept + told -> hro_pol_failed_send; latest 30 oldest-first scrolled to newest -> hro_thread_latest; 30 at a time with remaining count -> hro_thread_earlier; anchor kept -> hro_pol_earlier_place; per-person unread, own messages never unread, sending counts as read, per-conversation + total, at-newest arrival read -> hro_unread_counts; scrolled-up arrival place+notice+unread -> hro_unread_scrolled_up; seen rules incl. observer never counts and HM counts -> hro_seen; drafts per conversation across switch/view/reload -> hro_drafts; ended session prompts sign-in, resume, other user on same browser sees none, sending clears -> hro_pol_session_resume, hro_msg_compose.
- Candidate view (s7): own applications with title/team/candidate wording following stage -> hro_candidate_view; no notes/reason/rejected-from/positions/others/activity in any response, 404 for others' application -> hro_candidate_private.
- Seed (s9): read markers (Lena 1 unread) -> hro_unread_counts; seeded order/note and no re-seed -> hro_restart; long conversation -> thread rows.
- Views/desktop clarity (brief para 5) -> five hro_vis_* Likert rows; working sign-in and shared storage -> gates.
Runtime-contract items (node /app/server.js, port 3000, PORT, DB_PATH, health without DB, cwd independence, no shipped DB) are shared template runtime policy enforced by the unchanged template test.sh launch (env -i, PORT=3000, DB_PATH, uid 65534; task/tests/test.sh identical to rules/projects/webdev-task-template/tests/test.sh by diff) and by deterministic checkers, not judge criteria; per REVIEW_POLICY ('separate shared runtime policy from task-added technology requirements') this is not a criteria gap for row 26.
Residual Notes (no ungraded requirement found; P3, not blocking): (1) brief para 2 'when it is because a colleague moved that card a moment ago, tell me who' and rules s3 'their board shows the card where it really is' are graded in hro_stale_refused via a replayed request that accepts the name 'in the response or on screen'; an app whose UI shows only a generic error on 409 while its JSON names the person would pass that leg. This is a justified feasibility relaxation (a UI-driven stale conflict cannot be reliably produced against an app that syncs instantly by SSE), and UI put-back/reason/focus is graded on the capacity refusal in hro_refused_put_back. (2) rules s7 'signing in does not open one for them' has no dedicated leg; it is covered indirectly because protocol Z reads Lena's starting 1 unread without opening the conversation (hro_unread_counts), which an auto-opening candidate page would clear. (3) Draft/focus preservation while scrolled up (brief para 4 'whether I am reading or halfway through a reply') is graded at the newest message (hro_pol_live_thread) and place/notice while scrolled up (hro_unread_scrolled_up); the cross-product is not separately graded, but a re-render that clears the composer would surface in the at-newest case. (4) Undo blocked by a reopening since, and 'Identifiers are generated by the workspace' are not separately exercised; the former shares the move/reorder/reject conflict class graded in hro_undo_conflict, the latter is not browser-observable. Workbook internal annotation (flows may bundle several verifiers) and skill known false positive (one criterion covering a whole flow) applied: bundled flows such as hro_undo_conflict and hro_pol_session_resume are not gaps.
